name: Split screen
description: The frame splits: the speaker in the top half, the screen recording (or any b-roll) in the bottom half, each with rounded corners and a label chip. Then it returns to full frame.
when: Demos: when you walk through an app, a site or a doc while you talk, and the take has a screen recording.
needs: the camera footage and the screen recording (or b-roll) of the same moment
the part of the screen to show (cover) or the whole clip (contain)
a short label for each half
the cut time where it starts
